data.body: Implemented as Gerrit change 2255 — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2255 (commit 7c3c012b84ab). scripts/check_destructive_test_exec.py (167 LOC) + 11 tests + make lint wiring. Tests pin that both sanctioned remediations pass (the ${RM_CMD:-rm} seam and a : "${dir:?}" guard) while the incident shape fails, and that `set -euo pipefail` alone does NOT clear the gate — set -u fires on unset, not set-but-empty, and set-but-empty is what the incident had. make lint 0, typecheck 0, current tree clean. Not closing until Verified +1 and merged.
